title: Airbnb Reservation
description: A reservation for an Airbnb listing, including guest information, booking dates, pricing breakdown, and current status.

id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation.

confirmation_code.description: The human-readable confirmation code for the reservation.

status.description: The current status of the reservation.

listing_id.description: The identifier of the listing that was booked.

nights.description: The total number of nights in the reservation.

guests_count.description: The number of guests included in the reservation.

total_price.description: The total price of the reservation in the listing currency.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the reservation pricing.

host_payout.description: The amount to be paid out to the host after fees.

cancellation_policy.description: The cancellation policy that applies to this reservation.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the reservation was last updated.

Guest.description: The guest who made the reservation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the guest.

first_name.description: The first name of the guest.

last_name.description: The last name of the guest.

phone.description: The phone number of the guest, available after booking is confirmed.

profile_picture_url.description: The URL of the guest profile picture.

verified.description: Whether the guest has completed identity verification.

PricingBreakdown.description: A detailed breakdown of the reservation pricing.

nightly_total.description: The total for all nights at the nightly rate.

cleaning_fee.description: The cleaning fee charged for the reservation.

service_fee.description: The Airbnb service fee charged to the guest.

discount.description: Any discount applied to the reservation.

taxes.description: The total taxes collected for the reservation.
